\mxunit{enrichment-complex-rotations-exercises}{Rotations and complex numbers}
\mxsubtitle{Advanced high school · geometry \textperiodcentered{} Progressive exercises \textperiodcentered{} 09}

\begin{exercise}
Find $i(2-3i)$, then its modulus.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
Find the successive images of $1+i$ under four multiplications by i.
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
What is the centre of $z'=iz+2$?
\end{exercise}

\begin{exercise}
For $z'=a+i(z-a)$, prove $|z'-a|=|z-a|$.
\end{exercise}
